CHAPTER.VERS: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?
Jesus saith unto him, I am the way the truth and the life man cometh unto the Father but by me
Philip saith unto him, Lord, show us the Father, and it sufficeth us.

Jesus saith unto him,
been long time with you and
not known me Philip seen me
seen the Father and how sayest thou
Show us the Father
Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?

Jesus answered and said unto him, If man love me
keep my words and my Father
love him and
come unto him and make
abode with him
